workflow.description: The SWL-DOT graph this skill walks. Name a file beside this layer's config to replace the whole procedure. To change one node's instructions and keep the graph, use `references` instead

references.description: A folder of node instructions that change this skill's without copying the graph. In it, <node id>.md replaces that node's references file, and <node id>.extend.md is read after it and wins where they disagree
